data.name: CONDEMNED: Nightfall
data.detailed_description:
WHO CAN YOU TRUST?

CONDEMNED: Nightfall is a refreshing and dark take on the social deduction genre. Set in a noir 1950's manor, players are invited to a secluded gathering for the elite when a mysterious curse takes hold. Faced with the unsettling reality that nobody is who they seem, players must team up to complete objectives and earn safety in order to survive the Witching Hour. Those who survive the horrifying phase must then ban together for The Deliberation in an effort to rid the Cursed from the estate once and for all. But be warned- if players aren't able to sniff out their killer(s), the cycle continues...

ABOUT THE GAME:

  • TWO unique game modes for players to choose from: CURSED Mode or Story Mode.

    • CURSED is a social deduction mode featuring up to ten total players. 1-2 Players have been CURSED and up to 8 innocents must band together by completing objectives, collective safety shields and surviving the brutal Witching Hour. Following this phase, all players will congregate and cast votes to eliminate one player on the spot. Phases then repeat until all CURSED have been casted out or until all innocents have lost their lives.

    • Solo Story-Mode (Post Launch) gives single-players an exclusive narrative story surrounding the cast of CONDEMNED: Nightfall. Choose any player, and role, and go through a decision-driven cinematic story that accounts the origins of the mystery of the Cursed...

THE CHALLENGE:

Players will have limited time to split up to complete objectives. Upon completion, Innocent players will receive a buff to help them survive the night. Fail, however, and players are penalized and provide the Cursed players with additional advantages to help mark their prey. One player may also choose to prioritize the safety objective- but risks raising eyebrows come Deliberation.

THE WITCHING HOUR:

During this phase, The Cursed are free to roam around and enter their TRUE forms. While some innocents will look to escape, others will hide inside and try to survive the night without being found.

THE DELIBERATION:

All remaining players will gather together for a vote. One at a time, they must select whom they wish to cast out as the Cursed. Prior, chats are free to discuss the previous round and will each have one "suggestion" they can mark on a player they believe is Cursed.

CHARACTERS:

CONDEMNED: Nightfall will launch with an expanding roster of playable 1950's themed characters. Each character will have a slightly customizable look, allowing teams to have a unique combination in-game.

data.short_description: Survival horror set in a dark 1950's NYC. In this social deduction tactical RPG, a curse has fractured a gathering of guests. Will you fight to survive the night as an *Innocent*, or embrace the shadows and hunt your peers as *The Cursed*? Uncover the truth to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU 7th Gen 7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT, Minimum 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 56 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Spatial Audio Headphones
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU 8th Gen 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 Super / AMD 6600 XT, Minimum 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 56 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Spatial Audio Headphones

content_descriptors.notes:

Depicts player(s) shooting, killing other players and horror-themed enemies.

Depicts use of forms of 'medicine' to heal, revive or cure player(s).
